decision.reason: The change text and [ev-2bbc505de6bb] cover at least two separate breaking changes with different subjects. The first is the removal of wildcard view permissions for Kyverno controllers, replaced by a role binding to the default `view` role. The second limits where policy exceptions can be configured, controlled by `features.policyExceptions.namespace`. One assertion with one subject, change, applicability and consequence can't cover both, so this item needs to be split first. The evidence is also incomplete: the excerpt cuts off before the consequence ("will not impact policies during admission c…"), the Helm values for the permissions are left out ("as specified below"), and the old and new defaults for the exceptions namespace are never given. The rendered CRD diffs (e.g. [ev-9348cb2d7f00], [ev-b8120a2bb840]) cover different changes (new apiCall.default fields, removed v2alpha1 versions) and don't settle either item.
